resourceId.description: Foreign key to resources.resourceId — the `.claude/rules` file that declares this pattern

ordinal.description: Index of this glob in the rule file's own `paths:` list, from 0

pattern.description: The `paths:` glob verbatim, exactly as the rule file declares it

literalPrefix.description: The glob-free leading segments of `pattern`; may be empty. The longest path every match lives at or below.

witnessPath.description: First tree path this pattern matches, or null when it matched nothing or was never evaluated

projection-claude-rule-patterns.description: A row of the path-dependent `claude_rule_patterns` table
